assertions.description: Runtime tokens do not appear in nested tool results or emitted events.
Registry initialization rejects contracts whose handler is missing.
Runtime, telemetry, trials, and solver stubs fail with NOT_IMPLEMENTED and an owning phase.
Review-required calls fail closed and succeed only after service authorization and scope checks.
A mutating call with a stale revision returns REVISION_STALE without changing the store.
Concurrent calls with one expected revision yield one applied mutation and explicit stale results for the rest.
Every registered tool returns a contract-listed error for invalid arguments without throwing.
